description: Every launch on one day, ranked by upvotes (today by default; days run 00:00-23:59 UTC). Today's ranks are live; past days have final ranks, and #1 is the Debut of the Day. Use it when a user asks what launched today or on a date. Boosted launches are marked; payment never changes a rank.

date.description: Day as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

name: get_launches
title: Launches on a day
